gate.title: Gate & parked now

gate.noAreas: No parking areas yet. Add them in Parking areas to see how full each one is.
gate.emptyLog: No vehicles came in on these days.

vehicles.search: Number plate, pass number or name

form.findStudent: Type a name or admission number
form.licenceHint: Needed for a scooter, bike or car.

pass.noVisits: Not come through the gate yet.

pass.deleteHint: Only for a pass given by mistake. A vehicle that has used it keeps it — cancel it instead.

areas.title: Parking areas
areas.subtitle: Where vehicles park, who each place is for and how many it holds.
areas.name: Name
areas.nameHint: e.g. Staff car park, Cycle stand
areas.capacityHint: How many vehicles it holds. Empty: no limit.
areas.emptyHint: Add the staff car park, the students’ cycle stand, visitor parking … with how many each holds.
areas.deleteHint: Only an area that has never been used. Otherwise switch it off.

scan.title: Scan at the gate
scan.hint: Hold the sticker’s QR code to the camera, use a scanner gun, or type the number plate and press Enter. Each one is recorded at once.
scan.alreadyIn: Already inside since {{time}} — not recorded again
scan.notInside: Not parked inside — nothing to mark out
